dataset: PSDI Critical Micelle Concentration Data Collection

NIST_Table_of_Critical_Micelle_Concentra.interpretation: Observed concentration unit codes M=molar, D=wt/vol %, W=molal, P=wt %, N=normal, S=mol/kg, and R=varied were mapped from the original NBS NSRDS 36 legend. R denotes varied concentration units and is not a convertible unit. Evaluation-field values are counted only; no meanings inferred. All original fields and values remain unchanged.

externalCitationResolution.scope: Bibliographic metadata only; measurements not ingested.

NIST_Table_of_Critical_Micelle_Concentra.curationNote: Definitions for unit, evaluation, quality, source and reference fields are in nist-codebook.json. Of 4,973 numeric reference codes, 4,964 match the NIST index; six code-63021 rows have a citation resolved via PubMed (metadata only); three rows remain unresolved (45005 x2, 69016 x1). The CMC field can contain text/status values and should not be parsed blindly.

joinAudit.warning: A complete compound-number key join does not validate structure/name correctness. Compound identities and SMILES require source-level curation.
joinAudit.candidateConflict: Compound no. 2: NIST lists SODIUM OCTYL 1 SULFATE; PSDI LLM-added IUPAC/SMILES encode 2-ethylhexyl sulfate. Do not accept the structure join until source paper verification.

scopeLimits: This is a structural inventory, not row-by-row validation against the NIST publication.
No code conversion, unit conversion, outlier removal, CMC string parsing, compound structure correction, or model calibration was performed.
The table is a historical literature compilation with multiple methods, temperatures, additives, and source references; rows are not independent replicates.

NIST reference-code index reconciliation leaves three rows unresolved: 45005 (two rows) and 69016 (one row). Six 63021 rows are bibliographically mapped via PubMed, but paper measurements were not ingested; details are in reference-code-review.csv.
